entries.title: Genesis 13:1
segments: ¶And Abram went up out of Egypt with his wife and all he had, and Lot with him, and they came in to the South.

entries.title: Genesis 13:2
segments: Now Abram had great wealth of cattle and silver and gold.

entries.title: Genesis 13:3
segments: And travelling on from the South, he came to Beth-el, to the place where his tent had been before, between Beth-el and Ai;

entries.title: Genesis 13:4
segments: To the place where he had made his first altar, and there Abram gave worship to the name of the Lord.

entries.title: Genesis 13:5
segments: ¶And Lot, who went with him, had flocks and herds and tents;

entries.title: Genesis 13:6
segments: So that the land was not wide enough for the two of them: their property was so great that there was not room for them together.

entries.title: Genesis 13:7
segments: And there was an argument between the keepers of Abram's cattle and the keepers of Lot's cattle: at that time the Canaanites and Perizzites were still living in the land.

entries.title: Genesis 13:8
segments: Then Abram said to Lot, Let there be no argument between me and you, and between my herdmen and your herdmen, for we are brothers.

entries.title: Genesis 13:9
segments: Is not all the land before you? then let us go our separate ways: if you go to the left, I will go to the right; or if you take the right, I will go to the left.

entries.title: Genesis 13:10
segments: ¶And Lot, lifting up his eyes and looking an the valley of Jordan, saw that it was well watered everywhere, before the Lord had sent destruction on Sodom and Gomorrah; it was like the garden of the Lord, like the land of Egypt, on the way to Zoar.

entries.title: Genesis 13:11
segments: So Lot took for himself all the valley of Jordan, and went to the east, and they were parted from one another.

entries.title: Genesis 13:12
segments: Abram went on living in the land of Canaan, and Lot went to the lowland towns, moving his tent as far as Sodom.

entries.title: Genesis 13:13
segments: Now the men of Sodom were evil, and great sinners before the Lord.

entries.title: Genesis 13:14
segments: ¶And the Lord had said to Abram, after Lot was parted from him, From this place where you are take a look to the north and to the south, to the east and to the west:

entries.title: Genesis 13:15
segments: For all the land which you see I will give to you and to your seed for ever.

entries.title: Genesis 13:16
segments: And I will make your children like the dust of the earth, so that if the dust of the earth may be numbered, then will your children be numbered.

entries.title: Genesis 13:17
segments: Come, go through all the land from one end to the other for I will give it to you.

entries.title: Genesis 13:18
segments: And Abram, moving his tent, came and made his living-place by the holy tree of Mamre, which is in Hebron, and made an altar there to the Lord.
